prompts.sheet:
A single character model sheet on one sheet of paper, for animation reference.
One character only, shown three times in one frame: full-body front view,
full-body three-quarter view, and a row of three head-and-shoulders expressions
(neutral, determined, surprised). Plain light background, consistent lighting.

The character:
Kaito Ren, an 18-year-old male rooftop courier. Short messy black hair with a blunt fringe falling over the left eyebrow. Sharp amber eyes, thin angular face, light olive skin. Wears a dark grey high-collared courier jacket over a white shirt, cargo trousers and worn lace-up boots. Distinguishing marks: a long pale scar through the right eyebrow, and a frayed deep-red scarf always wound twice around his neck, one end hanging to his waist.

Black and white manga artwork, screentone shading, confident inked linework. Seinen style, detailed backgrounds, strong use of blacks. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no speech bubbles, no sound effects, no signatures, no watermarks and no panel borders anywhere in the image.
prompts.wide:
A single manga panel with exactly one person in it: the character shown in the
first attached image, a reference sheet. No other people, figures or silhouettes
anywhere in the panel.

Keep his face, hairstyle, eyes, outfit, scar and scarf EXACTLY as the
reference sheet shows. Do not restyle, age, or redesign him.
Only his pose, expression and surroundings change.

The second attached image is the location this panel takes place in. Keep its
architecture, props, lighting and time of day; put the character into it. Do not
copy any person from it.

The setting fills the rest of the frame.
Camera: Wide establishing shot, eye level, three-quarter view.
Action: He has just stopped walking and stands with one hand holding the end of his scarf, looking off to the right, alert.
Background: The location in the second attached image, seen whole from this camera, filling the frame around him.

verdictNotes: Same person in all three panels: scar, scarf, hair and face match the sheet.

The wide shot is the reference plate with Kaito standing in it: the stall, the row of paper lanterns, the steam, the vending machine on the left, the bicycle against the striped pillar on the right. The medium shot moves the camera and keeps the vending machine, lanterns, stall counter, gas cylinder and the railway overhead; the close-up keeps the lanterns and counter out of focus behind him.
Caveat: the wide shot keeps the plate’s camera almost exactly, which the prompt asked for ("seen whole from this camera"); the medium shot is the better proof that the place survives a new camera.
